I've compared the current invoice against your prior ticket history, and I want to flag something important rather than just repeating the same answer you got last time.

**Current invoice INV-30984:**
- One **settled** charge: $89 (July Pro subscription) — this is real and confirmed.
- One **pending authorization**: $89 — currently showing as a temporary hold, "expected to release within 3 business days."

**What I found in your history:** You had this exact same situation on TKT-77106 in March. At that time, you were told the second charge was "just a temporary authorization that clears in 3 days" and the ticket was closed. Per your own follow-up survey, that authorization did **not** release as promised — your bank confirmed the hold was tied to an internal review, not a standard authorization.

Given that history, I'm not comfortable just repeating "it'll clear in 3 days" and closing this out the same way. Here's what I'm doing instead:

1. I'm keeping this ticket **open** rather than resolving it on the assumption the hold will auto-clear.
2. I'm escalating internally so someone can verify whether this pending authorization is a genuine temporary hold or something that requires manual release/refund — the same failure mode from last time.
3. Please check back (or I'll follow up) in 3 business days. If the $89 authorization has **not** dropped off your card by then, let us know immediately and we will process a manual refund/release rather than asking you to keep waiting.

I don't have customer-facing detail beyond the invoice/transaction record to share on the "why" of the hold — but I've made sure this won't just get closed on a repeat assumption. You'll get a follow-up from our team confirming resolution once the authorization is actually cleared, not just expected to clear.

Sorry for the runaround last time — appreciate you flagging the pattern so we can fix it properly this round.
